description: This file is a shell script for testing various aspects of 'git archive' functionality, including archive creation, validation, handling of large files, virtual files, and remote interactions.

methods.name: check_zip
methods.description: Validates the extraction and contents of a ZIP archive, including filename correctness, file content correctness, and EOL conversion handling.

methods.name: check_added
methods.description: Checks for the presence and correctness of a specific added file within the extracted ZIP archive.
